subject: Re: Brightwell — Order Form addendum (capacity + SOW redlines)
messages:
From: Tom Hayes To: Neha Kapoor Cc: Laura Benson Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -07:00 Subject: Request: Order Form addendum — additional capacity & SOW update Hi Neha, Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is comfortable moving forward but we need to formalize the extra capacity and a small expansion to the SOW for the integration work.

High level: add 100 additional concurrent inference slots (reserved) starting July 1, 2025; adjust the per-token price for the burst tier to $0.0025; and include an SOW appendix that covers the three-week integration engagement with our platform team. I've attached a draft order form with our highlights and a one-page SOW we produced. Can you loop in legal and confirm what you need from us to finalize? We'd like this completed prior to our July 7 kickoff. Attachments: Brightwell_OrderForm_Draft_20250615.docx, Brightwell_SOW_Appx.pdf (see pages 1–2) Thanks, Tom Hayes Head of Cloud Integrations Brightwell Health ---

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@brightwell.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Order Form addendum — additional capacity & SOW update

Tom — appreciated, and glad to hear the team is ready.

Short answer: we can do the capacity increase and the SOW appendix. I'll coordinate legal review on the pricing and a couple of contract clauses that typically get flagged (liability cap language and data retention terms on the SOW).

Proposed next steps:
- I will ask Legal (cc'd Rishi) to review redlines and propose tracked changes by EOD Monday (6/16).
- Marissa will confirm invoice timing and whether this is billed as a one-time change order or added to the monthly commit.
- Karthik, can you confirm whether we need to provision extra GPUs before the July 1 start date for the reserved pool? (If so, we'll need a short lead time.)

We should plan a 30-min call Tuesday to walk through the redlines if that helps.

Neha Kapoor
Sr. Account Exec — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0187

Attachment: internal_note_for_sales.txt (internal checklist)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@brightwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Order Form addendum — additional capacity & SOW update

Tom / Neha — thanks for the context. I reviewed the draft order form and the SOW appendix. Attached is a PDF with tracked redlines and a short summary: BFW-Amendment-Redlines.pdf.

Key legal items I flagged (summary):
- Liability cap: propose maintaining existing MSA cap (12 months of fees) instead of removing the cap entirely. If Brightwell requires higher exposure, we can discuss narrowly tailored carve-outs.
- Data retention & audit: recommend explicit language that customer data used for model serving remains customer-controlled and that Redwood will retain logs for 90 days unless otherwise contracted.
- Pricing language: change "burst tier price" to be an addendum line item in the order form to avoid conflict with base-price definitions; incorporate an explicit effective date for the new per-token price.
- SOW acceptance: add an acceptance sign-off clause for the integration milestones (kickoff, staging validation, production handoff).

If Brightwell is comfortable with the liability cap as-is, we can move quickly. Otherwise, we should have a short call between legal teams to resolve.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel — Contracts & Commercial
Redwood Inference
Attachment: BFW-Amendment-Redlines.pdf

On Mon, Jun 16, 2025 at 09:12 AM Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@brightwell.com> wrote:
> Thanks — will review and get back with our counterpoints.
>

From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@brightwell.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Benson <laura.benson@brightwell.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@catalystlaw.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Order Form addendum — additional capacity & SOW update

Rishi / Neha — quick follow-up after we reviewed the redlines with counsel. Two items from our side:

1) Liability cap: we cannot accept a full 12-month cap on the additional capacity — our procurement requires a 24-month cap for reserved infrastructure spend. If Redwood can add a carve-out limiting exposure to direct damages on the capacity addendum only (and keep the rest of the MSA as-is), that would be acceptable to us.

2) Data retention: we are fine with a 90-day default retention if there is an option to increase retention for the integration logs for up to 12 months for audit purposes.

We are eager to finalize — if you can accept the two items above (cap carve-out on the addendum; retention option in SOW), we'll sign as soon as you send the final DocuSign. Can you expedite? We have an internal compliance review scheduled for July 6.

Thanks — Tom
---

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@brightwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Jun 2025 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightwell — Order Form addendum (capacity + SOW redlines)

Tom — great, thanks for the clear points. We reviewed internally and Rishi agreed to the carve-out approach for this addendum (liability cap limited to direct damages tied to the capacity addendum, 24-month cap for that line item). We will keep the remainder of the MSA caps unchanged. Rishi has updated the language in the attached final Order Form.

Data retention: we will include the option in the SOW to extend integration log retention up to 12 months upon request (billing for extended retention will be listed as an optional service in the SOW).

Next steps:
- Attached: RW_Brightwell_Final_OrderForm_20250621.pdf (final, with tracked acceptances integrated).
- DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ENVELOPE-abcdef123456 (same link in HubSpot). Please countersign by EOD Monday (6/23) so we can hit your July 1 provisioning target.
- Marissa: can you confirm billing flow (one-time change order vs. added monthly commit) and send invoice instructions.
- Karthik: please confirm provisioning lead time — we need to ensure GPUs are available and reserved for July 1.

Thanks all — happy to jump on a short call if anything else is outstanding.

Neha Kapoor
Sr. Account Exec — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0187

Attachments: RW_Brightwell_Final_OrderForm_20250621.pdf, BFW-Amendment-Redlines.pdf
